dedupe_keys.name: chinese city battery recycling costs and emissions 2020 2060

description: The AMR battery-recycling team publishes projected hydrometallurgical recycling costs and greenhouse gas emissions for 337 prefecture-level Chinese cities. The Figshare deposit contains a main Excel workbook with Cost and GHG sheets and a definitions workbook. The article states annual 2020–2060 coverage across six battery cathode chemistries and separate cost and emission components. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. These tables can set spatially varying recycling assumptions in electric-vehicle and waste-service supply-chain simulations. A caveat is that projections depend on technology, local prices and electricity mix, and are not audited facility accounts. Chemistry and city identifiers need consistent joins to retired-battery volumes before aggregation. The own repository metadata and article Data Records were read without opening spreadsheet cells or checking the model's intermediate values. Its MATLAB generation model is published in a separate GitHub repository; no exact related catalogue record was identified.
